D_2: The D₂ of the term symbol ¹D₂ (L = 2, J = 2)
E: Energy (ΔE: the shift of a level)
P_1: The P₁ of the term symbol ¹P₁ (L = 1, J = 1)
P_1/2: The P₁/₂ of the term symbol ²P₁/₂ (L = 1, J = 1/2)
P_3/2: The P₃/₂ of the term symbol ²P₃/₂ (L = 1, J = 3/2)
S_1/2: The S₁/₂ of the term symbol ²S₁/₂ (L = 0, J = 1/2)
g_l: g factor of the lower level
g_u: g factor of the upper level
m: Magnetic quantum number of a level (m_J)
m_J: Magnetic quantum number for total angular momentum
